0022600154.text: The Boston Celtics visit the Orlando Magic at 4-1 on the season, 4-0 at home and 0-1 on the road, and they have won four straight to sit 2nd in the Atlantic, one game back, and 3rd in the East. Orlando is 2-3 overall, 0-2 at home and 2-1 on the road, and has won its last game while ranking 9th in the East; Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Izaiyah Nelson and Noah Penda are unavailable for the Magic, and Devin Carter and Mitchell Robinson are out for Boston. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Boston won the 2025-26 series 3-1, and their most recent meeting, on April 12 in Boston, ended with the Celtics winning 113-108.
